sources.title: AssistantsLab/Tiny-Toxic-Detector · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Tiny-toxic-detector may struggle with ambiguous or nuanced language as any other model would. Even though benchmarks like Toxigen evaluate the model's performance with ambiguous language, it may still misclassify comments where toxicity is not clearly defined.

sources.title: Combining Deep Learning and Explainable AI for Toxicity Prediction of ...
sources.snippet: The proposed architecture achieves competitive results compared to traditional models, demonstrating the potential of deep convolutional networks in cheminformatics. Our findings emphasize the value of combining image-based representations with explainable AI methods to improve both predictive accuracy and model transparency in toxicology.
